class.name: OcgSelectmgrTriangularfrustumset
class.brief_description: This class is used to handle polyline selection. The main principle of polyline selection algorithm is to split the polygon defined by polyline onto triangles. Than each of them is considered as a base for triangular frustum building. In other words, each triangle vertex will be projected from 2d screen space to 3d world space onto near and far view frustum planes. Thus, the projected triangles make up the bases of selecting frustum. When the set of such frustums is created, the function determining selection iterates through triangular frustum set and searches for overlap with any frustum.

method.name: Init
method.description: Initializes set of triangular frustums by polyline

method.name: Build
method.description: Meshes polygon bounded by polyline. Than organizes a set of triangular frustums, where each triangle's projection onto near and far view frustum planes is considered as a frustum base NOTE: it should be called after Init() method

method.name: IsScalable
method.description: Returns FALSE (not applicable to this volume).

method.name: ScaleAndTransform
method.description: Returns a copy of the frustum with all sub-volumes transformed according to the matrix given

method.name: CopyWithBuilder
method.description: Returns a copy of the frustum using the given frustum builder configuration. Returned frustum should be re-constructed before being used.

method.name: OverlapsPoint_1
method.description: Always returns FALSE (not applicable to this selector).

method.name: DetectedPoint
method.description: Calculates the point on a view ray that was detected during the run of selection algo by given depth

method.name: SetAllowOverlapDetection
method.description: If theIsToAllow is false, only fully included sensitives will be detected, otherwise the algorithm will mark both included and overlapped entities as matched
